scripts.verify: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run verify && uv run --directory services/ai-vision-worker --with pytest,ruff pytest && uv run --directory services/ai-vision-worker --with pytest,ruff ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test && uv run --directory services/ai-vision-worker --with pytest pytest
scripts.lint: pnpm -r run lint && uv run --directory services/ai-vision-worker --with ruff ruff check .
